findings.reason: Two defects in one value: “已知能与…良好配合” is a literal passive for “known to work well”, and “在Local Operator中表现良好，欢迎…告诉我们” narrows the English “let us know if it works well”, which asks for the result either way. Asking for the model's performance restores the open solicitation. (Converges with first-round ZH-T3 on the narrowing; the calque is recorded here too.)

findings.current: 一些可以尝试的强大请求：
findings.reason: “强大” does not collocate with “请求” in Chinese (it modifies ability or features), so “Some powerful requests” has been rendered word for word. The list itself already shows the requests are capable; a verb-forward lead-in is the idiomatic replacement. (Converges with ZH-T2.)

findings.current: 让我们去智能体中心看看社区创建的智能体。点击导航栏中的“智能体中心”图标。 / 现在，我们来探索“设置”菜单，把Local Operator调整成你喜欢的样子。
findings.proposed: 接下来去智能体中心看看社区创建的智能体。… / 接下来看看“设置”菜单，把Local Operator调整成你喜欢的样子。
findings.reason: “让我们去…” and “我们来探索…菜单” are calques of “Let's visit” / “let's explore” and drift from the tour's own terse voice at navigate_schedules (“我们去…看看”). “探索菜单” also treats a menu as territory; 看看/了解一下 is what a native walkthrough says. Same screen family, two keys, one fix.

findings.current: （Windows或Linux）则会在应用自身的命令和页面上打开，适合你要找这类内容时使用。你也可以直接点击侧栏的“搜索”来打开它。
findings.proposed: （Windows或Linux）则直接打开应用自身的命令和页面，适合你要找这类内容时使用。你也可以直接点击侧栏的“搜索”来打开它。
findings.reason: “在应用自身的命令和页面上打开” reads as opening a window on top of a surface; “opens it on the app's own commands and pages” means the palette opens scoped to those sources. 打开应用自身的命令和页面 states that directly. (The fragment is judged inside the joined paragraph below.)

findings.current: 你已经了解了Local Operator的主要功能。接下来尽情探索，发现AI智能体为你提供帮助的各种方式吧。祝你自动化愉快。
findings.proposed: 你已经了解了Local Operator的主要功能。接下来尽情探索，发现AI智能体为你提供帮助的各种方式吧。祝你用得顺手。
findings.reason: “祝你自动化愉快” is “Happy automating” word for word; Chinese well-wishing needs an activity or experience (使用愉快 / 用得顺手 / 自动化之旅愉快). The closing line is high-visibility, so the calque is worth fixing even though it is understandable.
The namespace, ui.schedules.* and the sidebar all use 定时任务 for schedule, and the same step's body quotes “创建定时任务”. 周期任务 gives one step two names for one object. (Converges with ZH-T5.)

findings.current: 你也可以创建只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。 / 你也可以安排只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。
findings.proposed: 两处统一为「你也可以创建只在将来某个时间运行一次的任务。」
findings.reason: The two English values are byte-identical; the target renders one with 创建 and the other with 安排. Same sentence on two tour steps should use one verb. (Converges with ZH-T4.)

findings.current: ' 用于对话，' / ' 用于智能体和团队，' / ' 用于设置，以及' / ' 用于命令和页面。'
findings.proposed: 去掉四个前缀片段的引导空格（#用于对话，@用于智能体和团队，,用于设置，以及>用于命令和页面），与同段按键片段和 connector 的处理统一。
findings.reason: Optional consistency nit, not a rule breach: the sidecar says CJK may omit the structural space, and all four prefix fragments keep it while the keycap fragments and connector drop it. If normalised, do all four together and re-check the “，,” chip join in a rendered frame first; removing the space alone would glue the comma chip harder to 用于.

findings.current: 此对话框会把智能体的指令集发布到社区。发布需要Radient账户，注册免费，且不按智能体数量收费。确认前你可以查看详情。发布的只是描述智能体的内容，即名称、描述、指令和工具范围；对话、执行历史、记忆、计划和与本机相关的配置都不会离开你的电脑。提交前请确保智能体符合各项要求。
findings.proposed: 提交前，确保智能体符合各项要求。
findings.reason: The zh-CN style guide allows 请 only where the English says please (blocking dialogs). “Make sure your agent meets the required criteria before submitting” has no please, and the rest of this namespace is verb-forward without it. (Converges with ZH-T9.)

findings.current: 在文档中选中想要智能体改进的文字，按Cmd/Ctrl+K即可调出内联AI编辑器。
findings.proposed: 在文档中选中想要智能体改进的文字，按Cmd/Ctrl+K即可调出行内AI编辑器。
findings.reason: For an editor acting on selected text, Chinese product copy says 行内; 内联 is the CSS/function sense. Optional polish; no glossary row decides it. (Converges with ZH-T6.)

findings.current: 主动型智能体与定时任务
findings.proposed: 带定时任务的主动型智能体
findings.reason: “Proactive agents with schedules” is about agents that have schedules; “与” coordinates two separate things (agents and schedules). The step body is precisely about agents becoming proactive through schedules, so the possessive relation is worth keeping in the heading.

observations.note: Widths: every body paragraph is materially narrower than its English source (longest Chinese body 292 cells, agent_capabilities.body.1, against 457 English characters); no body exceeds its English width in cells. Cell counts only — no measured glyph widths and no pixel/overflow claim; the footer, step-7 chip paragraph and the two alt labels still need a rendered pass.

Controls: 下一步 = ui.onboarding.tour.action.next is used by the 36 advancing steps, 完成 = action.finish once on the final step (tour-steps.ts:1273), 返回 = action.back on the steps with a back button, and 关闭导览 = action.close is the Shepherd accessible close label (tour-steps.ts:1292). / with class names, aria-hidden inner markup, no text nodes and no /raster source; renderBlock wraps them in role="img" with aria-label = t(altKey). Typography: the 14 English double spaces were collapsed (0 double spaces in the target); titles are period-free, bodies keep 。; no ASCII comma/colon/question mark sits next to CJK; quote pairs are balanced; UTF-8, tab-indented, trailing newline, 18543 bytes.

source_observations.note: The Agent Hub card renders the literal English `Get` at src/renderer/src/features/agent-hub/components/agent-card.tsx:413 (aria-label `Download ${displayName}` is hardcoded too), so no locale shows a translated 获取 control. The tour quotes “获取”, which is the correct translation of the English quote but does not name anything on screen. Root fix belongs to agent-card.tsx (key the label); an interim catalogue-only workaround would quote “Get”, but that would not make the product localised. Not counted as a translator finding.

The create-schedule tour step anchors button[data-tour-tag="create-schedule-button"] (tour-steps.ts:1017-1021), whose visible label is ui.schedules.schedules_page.new_scheduled_task = 新建定时任务 (en: New scheduled task). The tour quotes “Create schedule” / “创建定时任务”, which is ui.schedules.schedule_form_dialog.create_schedule — a legacy dialog label, not the anchored control. English and Chinese share the defect; the translation is faithful. Root copy/tour fix, not a translator finding.

The comma chip sits where English says “teams, , for settings”, so the joined Chinese paragraph contains “，,” (“…用于智能体和团队，, 用于设置…”). This is structural to the shared run order and cannot be fixed cleanly in one catalogue value; fix the English run order/copy first. A rendered check of this paragraph is still owed (not performed here); no pixel claim is made.

download_agent.title = “Download an agent” → 下载智能体, while its body and the real control say “Get”. The mismatch exists in English; the target mirrors it. Root copy-consistency issue; not counted against the translator.

joined_renders.step7_paragraph_2: 急着开始对话？按下⌘K（Mac）或Ctrl+K（Windows或Linux），命令面板会直接以对话为搜索范围打开，一步跳到目标对话；而按下⌘⇧P（Mac）或Ctrl+Shift+P（Windows或Linux）则会在应用自身的命令和页面上打开，适合你要找这类内容时使用。你也可以直接点击侧栏的“搜索”来打开它。
